turnout.notes: South Carolina turnout rows use official SC VREMS 2024 General Election county voter-history statistics. The source page states registration numbers include all active voters plus some inactive voters printed on election lists, so rows are warning-required and are not interchangeable with active-registration denominators.

reviewCharts.warning: South Carolina review rows use official South Carolina Elections Database precinct presidential rows and President-versus-U.S.-House comparison rows. U.S. House is district-based rather than a single statewide comparison race; duplicate county/precinct keys from district splits are aggregated before comparison, and one nonzero presidential row lacks a nonzero House comparison and is kept as vote-share-only. Separately retained 2016, 2020, and 2024 precinct geometry is reviewed but remains unavailable until immutable delivery and production activation complete; 2012 remains blocked. Use these rows as advisory screening inputs, not confirmed findings.

historicalBaselines.warning: South Carolina historical baselines use official Elections Database county presidential CSV rows for 2012, 2016, and 2020. Use them as contextual jurisdictionTag flip baselines, not as 2024 certified-result rows. The 2012 precinct-geometry candidate remains separately blocked and is not activated by this county baseline.
